trans-unit.source: Here you manage one piece of equipment. The first sections show its details, its current status and who it is assigned to, its purchase and warranty information, and its planned maintenance. Use **Assign to Employee** and **Return** to change the assignment, and **Register Maintenance** to record maintenance work. Further down, **Assignment History** lists every assignment, **Maintenance History** lists every posted maintenance, and **Audit** shows who created the record and who changed it last. The **Picture** FactBox shows the picture of the equipment; use its actions to take, import, export or delete it. The **Equipment Summary** FactBox shows the status, the assigned employee and the warranty status. **Equipment Statistics** shows how many times the equipment was assigned, how many maintenance records were posted and their total cost. **Attachment Summary** counts the attached documents and images. The **Attachments** FactBox lists the files attached to the equipment; use **Attachments** to add files and set their category. **Equipment Notes** lists dated notes about the equipment; type a new line to add one. Notes cannot be changed or deleted. **Audit Trail** shows the lifecycle of the equipment: created, changed, assigned, returned, sent to maintenance and disposed.
trans-unit.target: Aqui gere um equipamento. As primeiras secções mostram os seus detalhes, o estado atual e a quem está atribuído, as informações de aquisição e de garantia e a manutenção planeada. Utilize **Atribuir a empregado** e **Devolver** para alterar a atribuição e **Criar manutenção** para registar trabalho de manutenção. Mais abaixo, **Histórico de atribuições** lista todas as atribuições, **Histórico de manutenção** lista toda a manutenção registada e **Auditoria** mostra quem criou o registo e quem o alterou por último. O FactBox **Imagem** mostra a imagem do equipamento; utilize as suas ações para a tirar, importar, exportar ou eliminar. O FactBox **Resumo de equipamento** mostra o estado, o empregado atribuído e o estado da garantia. **Estatísticas de equipamento** mostra quantas vezes o equipamento foi atribuído, quantos registos de manutenção foram registados e o seu custo total. **Resumo de anexos** conta os documentos e as imagens anexados. O FactBox **Anexos** lista os ficheiros anexados ao equipamento; utilize **Anexos** para adicionar ficheiros e definir a sua categoria. **Notas de equipamento** lista notas datadas sobre o equipamento; escreva uma nova linha para adicionar uma. As notas não podem ser alteradas nem eliminadas. **Pista de auditoria** mostra o ciclo de vida do equipamento: criado, alterado, atribuído, devolvido, enviado para manutenção e abatido.

trans-unit.source: The tiles count your equipment by status, show how many warranties are active, expire within 90 or 30 days or have expired, how many warranty alerts are open, how many pieces of equipment have planned maintenance due this month or overdue, and show the total cost of posted maintenance, this year's cost so far and the average cost. The **Operational Indicators** tiles show how many equipment requests are waiting for approval, how many warranties expire from today to the end of this month, how many maintenance records are open and not yet posted, and the total purchase cost of the equipment that is not lost or disposed of. **Total Equipment** includes lost and disposed equipment; the warranty and planned maintenance tiles do not. **Active Warranties** includes the warranties that expire soon, and **Warranties Expiring in 90 Days** includes those that expire within 30 days. **Overdue Maintenance Equipment** turns red when at least one piece of equipment has a next maintenance date before today. trans-unit.source: Register maintenance on equipment. Choose the equipment, the date and the type of maintenance, and add the vendor, the cost and who did the work.
